continuity: Jeok Cheongang’s treatment requires a Yin-Cold elixir containing at least one jiazi of energy within four months; the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng supplied by Ju Hwaran satisfies the core elixir requirement.
Dong Feng has taken Jin Taekyung into Cold-Ice Land to gather one hundred roots each of twenty-four medicinal herb varieties, while Mungyeong cares for the patients at the clinic.
Ju Hwaran secretly gave Taekyung the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng while calling it Hundred-Year-Old Snow Ginseng, and Taekyung plans to stop in Shaanxi to thank her.
plot: The Divine Physician explains that Jeok Cheongang’s unconsciousness results from a broken bodily balance, especially between Yin and Yang, caused by uncontrolled Scorching Yang Qi. Treatment requires an elixir containing at least one jiazi of energy and possessing Yin-Cold Qi, obtained within four months. Jin Taekyung provides a Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng given to him by Ju Hwaran under the guise of Hundred-Year-Old Snow Ginseng, satisfying the core requirement and completing the related Quest and achievement.

The Divine Physician leads Taekyung into Cold-Ice Land within the Mystic Gate Formation to gather medicinal herbs needed for treatment, while Mungyeong remains behind to care for the patients. A new nonrefusable Chain Quest requires one hundred roots each of twenty-four kinds of herbs.
translation_decisions: Render 오행 as Five Elements, 음양 as Yin and Yang, and 음한지기 as Yin-Cold Qi.
Render 초상비, 답설무흔, and 등평도수 as Flying Over Grass, Treading Snow Without a Trace, and Rising on Duckweed, Crossing Water.
Render 영약 찾아 삼만리 as Thirty Thousand Li in Search of an Elixir, 한빙지 약초 노예 as Herb Slave of Cold-Ice Land, and 심마니 as Mountain Herb Gatherer.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung’s party remains at Dong Feng’s hidden clinic in Sichuan, concealed by the Mystic Gate Formation.
Dong Feng has determined that Jeok Cheongang’s unconsciousness stems from disrupted balance and uncontrolled Scorching Yang Qi, and that treatment must begin within four months.
The Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng supplied by Ju Hwaran fulfills the core elixir requirement for Jeok Cheongang’s treatment.
Dong Feng has taken Taekyung into Cold-Ice Land to gather one hundred roots each of twenty-four medicinal herb varieties; Mungyeong remains at the clinic to care for the patients.
Venerable Myoryeong remains under treatment for the Black Hand Seal and is expected to recover with sufficient treatment and rest.
Tang Taesang was murdered, and Tang Sadok continues pursuing the culprit with members of the Sichuan Tang Clan.
The Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun, the Emei Sect Leader, and three Emei Elders were killed on Mount Emei by a one-armed middle-aged man.

Ju Hwaran remains the Yongbong Escort Bureau’s Young Bureau Head while investigating collaborators in Heo Jun’s betrayal; Song Ilseom remains with her temporarily before seeking Ju Hogun’s elixir in Xianyang.
open_questions: Can Taekyung gather the required herbs in Cold-Ice Land before the treatment deadline?
Will Dong Feng successfully treat Jeok Cheongang before his illness becomes fatal?
Will Venerable Myoryeong complete treatment and recover from the Black Hand Seal?
Who is the one-armed middle-aged killer, what is his purpose, and is he connected to Tang Taesang’s murder?
Which other Yongbong Escort Bureau members collaborated with Heo Jun, and how will the Zhongnan Sect’s leaders and wider organizers respond?
